intent: Replace title logo in the two user-selected concept images with the supplied poster logo.

edits.name: Space Toy Console
edits.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise logo replacement.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: a complete portrait Human Resources mobile home screen with a tactile ivory-and-cobalt toy-console UI.
Image 2 is a LOGO REFERENCE ONLY: the approved illustrated poster.
Update ONLY the main title wordmark on Image 1 to use the logo from the top of Image 2. Faithfully reproduce that specific two-line HUMAN RESOURCES logo: chunky forward-slanting cream letters, distinctive angular letter silhouettes and exaggerated H and R, slim coral-red offset extrusion/shadow, the small blue saucer emitting a mint triangular tractor beam as part of the A in HUMAN, and the broad curved mint swoosh beneath RESOURCES. Match the reference logo's proportions, arrangement, colours and distinctive letter construction rather than merely using another italic font. Both words are cream; coral belongs only to the narrow offset edge. Copy the logo only, not the poster background or large illustrated saucer/character.
Fit the approved logo cleanly inside the existing dark navy top title housing, above the unchanged credit/progression counters. Keep the ivory moulded casing and orange-tipped antenna details. Remove the old separate mint cow-abduction crest/decorative stars if necessary to give the approved logo clean space; the reference logo's own tiny UFO/beam and underline should carry that area. Do not overlay the old wordmark or duplicate saucer emblems.
Preserve EVERYTHING ELSE from Image 1: full 850x1850 portrait composition; farmland, barn, farmer, sheep, original central blue saucer and cow, lighting, framing; top credits 1,240 RESEARCH CREDITS and NEXT BLUEPRINT 42 / 60 CAPTURES; entire lower LOCATION / FARMLAND arrow selector, mint START RUN button, HANGAR and SETTINGS buttons. Do not redesign controls, change values, alter button text or add new elements. Make one finished image, no side-by-side or poster.
